# CMakeLists.txt — reconstruction self-check for bin/WMPDMC.exe
#
# Generated by @TOOL@.  Builds and runs the harness that re-derives the
# recovered facts (image digest, resource payload digests, GUIDs) from the
# original binary.  It does not rebuild the original module.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(wmp_recon_wmpdmc_exe C)

add_executable(wmp_recon_wmpdmc_exe recon/compile_check.c)
target_include_directories(wmp_recon_wmpdmc_exe PRIVATE recon)
target_compile_definitions(wmp_recon_wmpdmc_exe PRIVATE
    WMP_ARTIFACT_PATH="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../bin/WMPDMC.exe")
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
    target_compile_options(wmp_recon_wmpdmc_exe PRIVATE -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra)
endif()
